returned_blocker_sentences: After a Venus autonomous cycle studies a target, that target remains behind a retained reopening barrier:
Without this, a correctly WITHHOLDing cycle can close and immediately select the same unresolved issue again, converting principled STOP into repeated self-generated activity.
- open autonomous cycle: target blocked unconditionally;
- resolved cycle: target remains blocked while `target.updatedAt <= cycle mergedAt/closedAt`;
- missing target timestamp: fail closed behind prior barrier.
The worker's own initial annotation does not create a false reopen because it occurs before the later cycle outcome timestamp.
A newer target update is only a reopening condition.
